title: upgrade: attention kernels -> flashattnV2 + fused ops, rotary/rope fixes, kv-continuous-batching + scheduler tweaks
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Reduce per-token latency and tail latency for common chat workloads and improve throughput on long-context models by upgrading our attention kernels to FlashAttentionV2, enabling fused rotary/rope ops, and improving KV-cache continuous batching + scheduler heuristics.

Summary of changes: upgraded third_party/flashattn -> v2.1, added fused rotary/rope support to fused_attn kernel, implemented a path that falls back to rotary when model uses rotary embeddings and to rope when model uses classic RoPE (auto-detected by model metadata). Integrated fused ops into runtime kernel selection logic (runtime/kernel_selector.cc) with heuristics for seq_len and head_dim.

KV/Batching changes: added continuous batching support to kv_cache manager to combine in-flight requests that share prefix keys, implemented a new scheduler heuristic that prioritizes low-latency small batches for interactive routes and large throughput batches for background routes. Added metrics to observe batching decisions (metrics: batch.size.hist, batch.latency.p50/p95, kv.merge.count).

Compatibility: new kernel supports both rotary and rope but preserves previous codepaths for models compiled without fused ops. Added a flag `RUNTIME_USE_FLASHATTNV2` gate for staged rollout.

Testing & CI: unit tests for fused kernels and rotary/rope correctness, integration tests for kv continuous batching, end-to-end perf tests that run on small (A100) and medium (H100) fleets. Benchmarks: +18% throughput on long-context (16k) llama-like configs, -12% p95 latency for interactive chat (context 2k) on H100 in our perf lab.

Rollout plan: feature-flag gated in main, canary on dedicated infra (10% traffic) for 48h, metrics gating for error rate, latency regressions, and cost. Full rollout after 72h if gates pass.

Checklist:
- [x] Kernel upgrade integrated and unit-tested
- [x] Fused rotary/rope ops implemented and validated
- [x] KV continuous batching implemented and instrumented
- [x] Scheduler heuristics added and tested
- [x] Feature-flag and canary rollout plan documented

Related: Linear ENG-4123, ENG-4280. See design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/doc/ENG-4123/flashattn-v2-fused-ops-rope-rotary for design details.
